recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s-style collage featuring a large, cutout vintage illustration of a dancer against a solid blue background, paired with a framed photograph of a musical group and bold, heavy typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Dancer figure as the primary silhouette and visual anchor
Framed group photo in the upper-left quadrant balancing the dancer's movement
Bold yellow text at the top contrasting with the deep blue field
White placard overlaying the dancer's torso for secondary text
coreInvariants: Vintage illustrative style for the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large female dancer figure dominates the right and center, while a smaller rectangular group photo occupies the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central dancer figure, specifically the white placard on her chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold yellow header, moves down to the group photo, follows the dancer's limbs to the central white placard, and ends at the bottom-right logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of solid blue background provide breathing room for the busy collage elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow for primary header text and logo accents
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and green within the inset photo and dancer's shoes
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across primary colors with high value contrast between white placards and dark blue background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights and colors for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Green rectangular frame for inset photo
White rectangular placard with hanging string detail

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and tight counters of the display text
Classic grotesque feel with similar proportions
Clean, bold sans-serif that fits the era's commercial style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid cobalt blue background. In the top left, place a rectangular photograph of four men in red suits with a thin green border. In the center-right, place a large cutout illustration of a vintage ballerina/dancer in a dynamic pose. Add a white rectangular placard over her torso with thin black lines suggesting it is hanging from her neck.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in extra-bold yellow sans-serif at the top left. Add the secondary title in extra-bold black sans-serif centered on the white placard. Place a small yellow 'STEREO' box in the top right and a yellow graphic logo in the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant blue?
Is the main text extra-bold and yellow?
Is the dancer figure a vintage-style cutout?
Is the inset photo framed in green?

postGenerationChecks: Check for tight kerning in the display text
Ensure the white placard appears as a physical overlay
Verify the green border on the inset photo is thin and uniform
Confirm the blue background is a single flat color
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid background + Inset framed photo (top left) + Large cutout figure (center) + Bold sans-serif header (top) + Placard text overlay (center).
